children: New Zealand premium carpet maker's preliminary FY26 revenue rose 21% yr/yr, driven by Elco Direct
Preliminary net loss after tax was NZ$11.4 mln, with normalised EBIT loss narrowing yr/yr
Results reflect challenging market conditions and one-off items; outlook cautious for FY27
Company says timing and pace of broader market recovery remain uncertain
Immediate objective is to return to profitability and positive operating cash flow
WOOL DEMAND - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by Elco Direct, with increased wool demand and higher prices in 2H26
COST REDUCTION - Co implemented significant cost out programme, reinvesting savings to drive revenue and improve inventory quality
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS - Napier yarn plant now fully operational, helping reduce product and supply chain costs and improve product quality
